question: Should the rebased fix land as one combined parser, stale-queue, and pdfMaxBytesMb extraction-limit change, or should the compatibility-sensitive config/session behavior be split from the stack-safe parser fix?
rationale: The stack-safe parser work is a clear bug fix, but changing an existing config key's runtime meaning and dropping persisted failed queue items are upgrade/session behavior choices that automation should not silently decide.

options.title: Rebase Combined Fix
options.body: Port the UI changes to current main and keep the bounded pdfMaxBytesMb and stale-queue behavior with explicit tests, docs, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Split Parser First
options.body: Land only the stack-safe parser and queue cleanup needed for the P1 attachment failure, then review the pdfMaxBytesMb extraction semantics separately.

options.title: Pause Direction
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until a maintainer decides whether pdfMaxBytesMb should affect inbound document extraction at all.

recommendation.title: Rebase Combined Fix
recommendation.body: Port the UI changes to current main and keep the bounded pdfMaxBytesMb and stale-queue behavior with explicit tests, docs, and upgrade proof.
